hypotheses.h0: always mask every flatline detected by the frozen Observation
hypotheses.h1: propose detected flatline actions with support singleton first-order credit > 0; execute the exact grouped cohort iff exact support gain > 0

action_value_guard_budget_diagnostic.scientific_role: exposed flatline Program-conditioned ActionValueGuard mechanism test; not Capability, Memory, Promotion, or transfer evidence

support_query_splits.B=0: no support; query all 8 evaluation series
support_query_splits.B=1: 8 singleton supports; query the other 7 series

causal_hypothesis: A one-block marginal intervention credit measured on one validation fold predicts whether masking that block is useful on a disjoint validation fold; the compiled mask/abstain policy should reduce dataset-level harm relative to always masking every detected flatline.
claim_limit: Development-only exposed Source diagnostic. Marginal credit is conditional on this Ridge model, the other training rows, and the support fold; it is not intrinsic point quality or cross-dataset capability evidence.

configuration.metric: per-series sMASE, equal mean within validation fold
configuration.selection_rule: mask unit iff support-fold marginal credit > 0; else abstain

credit_definition: sMASE(keep all observed flatlines) - sMASE(mask only this unit), with all other training rows and intervals fixed

unit_credit.credit_semantics: validation sMASE(keep all) - validation sMASE(mask only this row x interval); positive favors masking
